notes.title: The Horror Grows in the Darkness
notes.notes:
Crafting the perfect atmosphere for a horror game isn't just a detail—it’s the soul of the experience. Every light, every shadow, and every object tells a silent story, gradually building fear. Our mission with Tapes of Fear is to ensure that every room isn't just a space, but a living fragment of horror.

"I walked through the same halls, the same dark rooms, but something had changed. The darkness was thicker, every object whispered a more sinister story, and every shadow concealed a new terror."
